userFeedback: The top seam solids followed the rim profile but still appeared to sit on top of the stone; corrected in v6 by replacing the rim itself with capped stone segments.

reviews.notes: Each radial seam now bends continuously over the rounded torus surface and terminates inside the stone silhouette without a floating planar endpoint.
All sixteen vertical seams follow the changing wall radius from the upper rim to the lower ledge instead of hanging at one constant radius.
Upper-rim seams follow its torus cross-section and upper-bowl seams follow the lathed profile; no side endpoint floats in the close proof render.
The new seam pieces are closed solids. LOD0 remains below budget with zero degenerate faces and loose vertices; the remaining accepted open edges belong to water and thin ornament surfaces.
The corrected asset remains at five materials, eight LOD0 draw calls, three colliders, and strictly decreasing LOD0/1/2 triangle counts.
